title: The FF normalization batch two (census 945)

banner.title: The FF normalization batch two - the letters h-r, 60 of 185 defs rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission
banner.provenance: The FF normalization - the per-book schema pass continues for the Fiend Folio (the R879 normalizer doctrine, the R1009-R1014 MM1 arc, R1016 the OA book close, R1017-R1020 the MM2 arc closed, R1021 the letters a-g): the letters h-r rewritten to the canonical FIELD_ORDER emission, byte-exact against the landed normalize_registry.py; all 420 patches are anchored sentinel inserts under the single-line anchor doctrine (the R1021 aarakocra lesson); no reorders, no comma sites, no pin repairs - the FF book carries no fragment grids; the loader reads the sentinels under the R879 uniform coercer doctrine already live on the 787 normalized MM1, MM2 and OA defs

audit_comment: THE FF NORMALIZATION, BATCH TWO - the letters h-r, 60 of 185 defs rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission, byte-exact against the landed normalize_registry.py; every patch an anchored sentinel insert.
include_after: #include "rules/ff/letters_a_to_g.h"  // R1021: the FF normalization batch one

consts.name: fq2Round
consts.comment: the FF normalization batch two - the letters h-r, 60 of 185

consts.name: fq2DefsNormalized
consts.comment: the FF defs rewritten to full-field canonical form this batch - the letters h-r

consts.name: fq2FfTotal
consts.comment: the FF def census - unchanged by the batch

consts.name: fq2FfNormalizedAfter
consts.comment: the FF defs carrying the full-field emission after this batch - the letters a-r

consts.name: fq2FfRemaining
consts.comment: the FF defs still sparse after this batch - the letters s-z, the book closes next round

consts.name: fq2SchemaKeys
consts.comment: the canonical FIELD_ORDER length - every FF def emitted with all 57 keys

consts.name: fq2InsSites
consts.comment: the anchored insert sites - 1620 inserted lines, all sentinel fields

consts.name: fq2CommaSites
consts.comment: the trailing-comma whole-line rewrites - NONE this batch, every text field already carried the Lua-optional comma

consts.name: fq2ReorderDefs
consts.comment: the defs needing whole-line rewrites - NONE this batch, the fields already in canonical FIELD_ORDER

consts.name: fq2PatchEntries
consts.comment: the file patches this round - 420 monster windows, all anchored sentinel inserts

bools.name: fq2NormalizerCensusLive
bools.comment: the landed normalize_registry.py reads its full 1338-def census - the registry floor live

bools.name: fq2FullFieldEmission
bools.comment: every rewritten def carries all 57 keys - string sentinel n/a, integer sentinel -1, saveAsBonus the loader zero default

bools.name: fq2InsertOnly
bools.comment: zero whole-line rewrites, zero deletes - every patch an anchored insert, the single-line anchor doctrine (the R1021 aarakocra lesson held, the second engine pass simulated in full pre-handoff)

bools.name: fq2NoClassedDefs
bools.comment: no classed defs in the letters h-r - zero saveAs keys, the R155 contract untouched
